Navidrome / Subsonic Browser

By: santirod

Browse and stream music from a Navidrome server — or any Subsonic API compatible server directly inside foobar2000.

Features
  • Browse your full library: Artists, Albums, Songs, with search.
  • Add a whole album or artist to the playlist in one click; double-click a song to play.
  • Native navidrome:// URI scheme: playlist entries store a stable URI instead of a transient stream URL, so saved playlists survive credential rotation or a server URL change. The stream URL is resolved at playback time.
  • Streaming runs through foobar2000's built-in HTTP input, so MP3, FLAC, OGG and other formats decode through the normal pipeline.
  • Album art fetched from the server, shown in Now Playing and playlists.
  • Token-based authentication (salted MD5); credentials stored in foobar2000's config.
  • Integrates under Preferences > Media Library > Library viewers.

Platforms
  • macOS
  • Windows x86, x64, and native ARM64 (ARM64EC)
A single component package covers all platforms; foobar2000 loads the right binary automatically.

Current version: 1.31.2, released on 2026-10-19
